# t28.1 — Protected internal database-size endpoint

## Result

Implemented `GET /internal/db-size` for the supported keep-alive/size-check use case. It requires
`Authorization: Bearer <INTERNAL_TOKEN>`, performs constant-time token comparison, returns 404 when
the token is absent, invalid, or unconfigured, and is omitted from OpenAPI. After authorization it
queries PostgreSQL `pg_database_size(current_database())` and reports the byte count, 500 MiB
limit, and percent used. Database query failures return a sanitized 503.

The production checklist remains unchecked. The keep-alive workflow, GitHub secrets, and hosted
verification remain unavailable. `POST /internal/purge` is still planned and is not implemented.
